_comment: Fast-lookup index of every key file in the Archx repository: inputs, outputs, and single responsibility.

Cargo.toml.purpose: Rust crate manifest for the zero-dependency archx compiler.

src/main.rs.purpose: CLI driver: flag parsing, extension/clobber checks, temp .ll handling, cross-platform clang invocation, and --run execution.

src/diag.rs.purpose: 1-based source Span and Diagnostic error type.
inputs: line: usize, col: usize, message: String

src/token.rs.purpose: Lexical token enum and human-readable token descriptions.

src/lexer.rs.purpose: 4-space indentation-aware UTF-8 lexer with string escape decoding.

src/ast.rs.purpose: AST definitions for Program, StructDef, Func, Stmt, Expr, AssignTarget, and Type.

src/parser.rs.purpose: Bounded-depth recursive-descent + iterative-unary parser producing ast::Program.

src/codegen/mod.rs.purpose: LLVM IR module orchestrator, struct cycle/topological layout, Codegen state, function frames, and IR formatting helpers.

src/codegen/analysis.rs.purpose: Pure AST static analyses: SoA escape detection, monotonic while stride verification, mutation/return sets, and constant int folding.

src/codegen/stmt.rs.purpose: Statement, region: block, transparent AoS-to-SoA allocation, and assignment lowering.

src/codegen/loops.rs.purpose: while, for i in a..b, for i in a..b step k, and for x in arr lowering with preheader range guards.

src/codegen/expr.rs.purpose: Expression lowering: literals, variables, indexing, struct fields, checked i64 ops, short-circuit booleans, and 16B prefix-SSO strings.

src/codegen/calls.rs.purpose: User fastcc calls, positional struct constructors, and builtins (print, len, push, pop).

src/codegen/ownership.rs.purpose: Deterministic RAII ownership: statement temporaries, recursive drops, deep clones, and region return heap promotion.

src/codegen/memory.rs.purpose: Checked malloc/calloc/realloc (align 16, 2^47 cap), element store/load/fill loops, and bounds-check elision proofs.

src/codegen/runtime.rs.purpose: On-demand LLVM IR runtime helpers (@archx_region_*, @archx_str_*, panic handlers) and libc/LLVM intrinsic declarations.
outputs: Private LLVM IR helper functions and declares

src/codegen/tests.rs.purpose: Unit tests for LLVM IR codegen, bounds elision, SoA structs, SSO strings, and region escape checking.

tests/cli.rs.purpose: Cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows) end-to-end CLI and execution integration tests.

benchmarks/run.sh.purpose: Builds, verifies stdout via cmp, and times C vs Rust vs Archx across primes, arrays, and composite suites.

.github/workflows/ci.yml.purpose: 3-OS GitHub Actions CI workflow (Linux, macOS, Windows), ASan+LSan verification, benchmarks, and repo-committed logs/test-history.
